description: 인천광역시 남동구_하천현황 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 인천광역시 남동구. 인천광역시 남동구 하천현황에 관한 공공데이터로, 각 하천의 고유 연번, 유형, 하천명, 시작 위치와 끝 위치, 하천의 폭(미터 단위), 연장 길이(킬로미터 단위), 그리고 유역 면적. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
